description: This file defines the final class CallableArgumentsExtractor within the Twig\Util namespace, which is responsible for extracting and validating argument nodes for callables in Twig templates. It handles named, positional, and variadic arguments, performing syntax and argument count checks, and converting argument structures into appropriate expressions.

classes.name: CallableArgumentsExtractor
classes.description: Final class responsible for extracting and validating arguments for callables in Twig templates, supporting named, positional, and variadic arguments, with syntax validation and argument count checks.

methods.name: extractArguments
methods.description: Main method to extract and validate argument nodes, handle named and positional arguments, support variadic arguments, and throw syntax errors if arguments are invalid or missing.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Converts argument names to a normalized lowercase string without underscores.

methods.name: toSnakeCase
methods.description: Converts CamelCase or PascalCase names to snake_case.

methods.name: getCallableParameters
methods.description: Retrieves and processes callable function parameters, accounting for special parameters like environment, context, and any variadic arguments.
